title: Second-Stage Resource Bounds
statement: Let the learning input have a positive dimension and a positive rational accuracy at most one half, and let its integral Fourier norm bound be at least one. For every Boolean function on the sign cube of that dimension and every query state, the second-stage program uses zero random examples, makes at most the coefficient sample count in membership queries, and uses at most its coefficient work budget in local work.
hypotheses_covered: Twice the accuracy numerator is at most its denominator
The Fourier norm bound is at least one
The target is a Boolean function on the input dimension
A Goldreich–Levin query state is given
